serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: DOMA’s DX Engage Government Platform is a digital exchange and collaboration platform. DX Engage integrates leading edge Natural Language Processing and Artificial Intelligence solutions to securely ingest, digitize, store, access, share and collaborate with information. Capabilities also include physical to digital conversion, custom and automated workflows, e-signature, redaction, translation, extraction and dynamic search within the suite of integrated cloud hosted tools. DX Engage Government Platform is delivered as a PaaS/SaaS offering using a multi-tenant Government-Only Cloud computing environment.
